marks.name: The manual door sits under the stack it replaces
marks.why: Pick a preset on the slider, or open the door directly beneath the line that names it. Two neighbouring choices, nothing in between.

marks.name: Set up, not Sets up
marks.why: Row titles are verbs and sentence case throughout. The stop-bundle explainer is gone; so is the end-to-end latency note and the all-in prose.

name: after7-backup-chain
pre: (async()=>{document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');document.documentElement.style.colorScheme='light';const wait=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>x.textContent.includes('Or configure models manually'));if(b&&b.getAttribute('aria-expanded')==='false')b.click();await wait(900);document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Configure STT vendor and credential"]')?.click();await wait(1000);const add=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='Add backup');add&&add.click();await wait(700);})()

marks.name: Vendor and model on one row
marks.why: The pair a person names together is one decision. Its credential sits directly under it, primary and backup alike.

marks.name: Every backup is a full row with its own switch and key
marks.why: Backup 01 carries vendor, model and credential. The switch takes it out of the chain without losing the key; the cross removes it.

marks.name: Add backup appends the next one
marks.why: A slot can hold a chain, tried in order. The vendors already used, primary included, drop out of the next picker.

marks.name: Opening is a row, not a floating title
marks.why: System prompt, Opening and Failure message are three separate decisions, so each takes the builder's own label column and the hairline between them does the separating.

marks.name: What the agent says is set in quotes and italics
marks.why: Spoken lines are never confusable with the interface's own words. The greeting, the AI sentence and the composed line all carry it.

marks.text: The agent waits and answers what it hears
marks.name: Caller first hides what it disables
marks.why: A row of greyed-out controls with prose sitting in the input read as broken. One sentence says the same thing and nothing is left to misread.

name: after7-batch-contacts
pre: (async()=>{document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');document.documentElement.style.colorScheme='light';const wait=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));await wait(1200);const pickBatch=async()=>{for(let i=0;i<20;i++){const r=[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=radio][value="batch"]')].find(e=>e.getBoundingClientRect().width>0);if(r&&r.getAttribute('aria-checked')==='true')return true;if(r)r.click();await wait(400);}return false;};await pickBatch();await wait(1600);document.getElementById('wz-2-contacts')?.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});await wait(700);})()

marks.name: Picking Batch seeds the first run and opens its list
marks.why: Choosing Batch used to change nothing on screen. The caller ID and the contact list now appear at the point of decision, with the table already showing.

marks.name: Caller ID, not how callers reach you
marks.why: An outbound run dials from a number; it does not receive on one. The old label asked the inbound question.

name: after7-runs-open
pre: (async()=>{document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');document.documentElement.style.colorScheme='light';const wait=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));await wait(1200);const pickBatch=async()=>{for(let i=0;i<20;i++){const r=[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=radio][value="batch"]')].find(e=>e.getBoundingClientRect().width>0);if(r&&r.getAttribute('aria-checked')==='true')return true;if(r)r.click();await wait(400);}return false;};await pickBatch();await wait(1600);const h=[...document.querySelectorAll('p')].find(x=>x.textContent.startsWith('Campaign runs'));h&&h.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});await wait(700);})()

marks.name: The first run opens as a form, not an empty state
marks.why: A draft run is an unfinished form. Its fields are asked straight away; New run appears only once a run has left draft, and the No-runs-yet explainer is gone.
